# Public Social Account Analyzer

> Agent Skill and CLI toolkit for auditing, collecting, and analyzing public creator and brand accounts across Bilibili, Douyin, Weibo, and Xiaohongshu with immutable audit artifacts.

## Overview
public-social-account-analyzer provides deterministic, auditable public data collection and content analytics for social media platforms. It gathers public profile data, video/post metrics, engagement breakdowns, and audience retention into immutable JSON/CSV artifacts, producing structured strategic reports.

- **Category**: Social Media Analytics / Content Intelligence / Agent Skill / Python CLI
- **Author**: Luckycat133
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer
- **License**: MIT
- **Runtime**: Python >= 3.9

## Supported Platforms & Capability Matrix
| Platform | Capability | Support Level | Fallback Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Bilibili (B站)** | Full profile, video history, engagement metrics, tags | P0 (Production) | Bounded retry, public API + optional authorized session |
| **Douyin (抖音)** | Video statistics, captions, play counts | P0 (Experimental) | SSR / ephemeral browser, creator OpenAPI |
| **Weibo (微博)** | Post timeline, reposts, comments count | P1 (Experimental) | Public AJAX pipelines |
| **Xiaohongshu (小红书)** | Note cards, interaction stats, keywords | P1 (Experimental) | Modern/legacy state parsing, partial sample safeguards |

## Core Principles
1. **Immutable Audit Artifacts**:
   - Never overwrites historical snapshots; each collection attempt creates an isolated, verifiable dataset directory.
2. **Defensive Anti-Scraping Compliance**:
   - Immediately stops on captchas, login walls, or rate limits. Never fabricates empty data as "success"; clearly marks incomplete crawls as `PARTIAL`.
3. **Agent-Native Discovery**:
   - AI agents accept pure creator names, autonomously find and verify official profile URLs, and invoke the collection pipelines without manual link hunting.

## Quickstart

### Installation
```bash
# As OpenClaw Agent Skill
openclaw skills install @luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer

# Or local Python environment
git clone https://github.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer.git
cd public-social-account-analyzer
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

### Run Pipeline
```bash
# Collect Bilibili creator archive
python3 skill/scripts/collect_bilibili_complete.py \
  "https://space.bilibili.com/<uid>" \
  --out-prefix workspace/bilibili-collection

# Generate analytics report
python3 skill/scripts/run_pipeline.py \
  --input workspace/bilibili-collection-attempt-1 \
  --output workspace/bilibili-analysis
```

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What makes this different from generic web scrapers?
It is structured specifically for AI Agents (Agent Skills). Output datasets are structured for direct LLM ingestion, sentiment analysis, and topic modeling, with built-in data verification and rate-limit safety checks.
